name: pagedjs
description: Chunks up a document into paged media flows and applies print styles
author: Fred Chasen

scripts.specs: npm run build && playwright test --config specs/playwright.config.js
scripts.specs:pdf: npm run build && PAGED_PDF_REVIEW=true playwright test --config specs/playwright.config.js --ui
scripts.specs:pdf:update: npm run build && PAGED_PDF_REVIEW=true playwright test --config specs/playwright.config.js --update-snapshots=all
scripts.docker-test: docker build -t pagedmedia/pagedjs . && docker run -it --rm --ipc=host --user pwuser -v $(pwd)/specs:/home/pwuser/pagedjs/specs pagedmedia/pagedjs npm test
scripts.docker-specs: docker build -t pagedmedia/pagedjs . && docker run -it --rm --ipc=host -v $(pwd)/specs:/home/pwuser/pagedjs/specs pagedmedia/pagedjs npm run specs
scripts.docker-update-specs: docker build -t pagedmedia/pagedjs . && docker run -it --rm --ipc=host -v $(pwd)/test-results:/home/pwuser/pagedjs/test-results pagedmedia/pagedjs npm run specs:pdf:update
